rootCause: 3.10.3 loaded the legacy folder runtime and the new Windows folder runtime simultaneously.
The Windows folder runtime observed and mutated the same Layers subtree, rewrote an observed hidden attribute and polled folder status periodically, creating a self-sustaining render/mutation loop.
GPT attachments called makePreview although the helper was missing.
Core connection and layer rendering assumed a fully initialized project during startup.

performanceSmoke.environment: Headless Chromium with mocked extension APIs and inlined local assets
performanceSmoke.version3103: DOMContentLoaded did not complete within 30 seconds

distribution: Manual development ZIP. Install into the actual Desktop folder currently loaded by Chrome and reload the same extension card.
binaryNote: Do not claim the full ZIP is stored remotely until its remote byte size and SHA-256 match.
